entities.summary: Wilkes Land is a large district of land in eastern Antarctica, formally claimed by Australia as part of the Australian Antarctic Territory, though this claim has been held in abeyance for the period of the operation of the Antarctic Treaty, to which Australia is a signatory. Wilkes Land is a region. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
